verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI is an API-first service, so it runs headlessly by design. It offers async and single-call HTTP transcription, WebSocket streaming, Python/TypeScript SDKs that handle upload, submit and polling in one call, and a published OpenAPI spec, all of which suit unattended scripted automation. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline guidance or examples, an official CLI for shell-based automation, independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI usage.
